entities.summary: Hans Christian Harald Tegner, known as Hans Tegner, was a Danish artist and illustrator. He is primarily known for his illustrations of literary works by Hans Christian Andersen and Ludvig Holberg and for his work for the Bing & Grøndahl porcelain factory.
